notes.title: Extra game mode added.
notes.content:
Extra game mode added.

[h2]Brief Description[/h2]
[olist]
[*] This is a mode for advanced players (recommended to play after completing the story).
[*] Attack the randomly generated dungeons and reach the bottom level to complete the game!
[*] Equipment, levels, and acquired items are reset each time.
[*] You can use magical ingredients to release an element. Elements released with magical ingredients are inherited even if you die.
[*] Magical ingredients are gone when you start the game. Use it up as much as possible.
[*] 
[*] 
[/olist]

I've already found some problems and will fix them in an update soon.
Also, I will be adding online rankings.

notes.title: About next update
notes.content:
I am currently implementing [b]new game mode[/b]
If all goes according to schedule, I'll have it done and updated by the end of this month.
Details of the new game mode.
[list]
[*] A more roguelike mode with permanent death. The balance will be adjusted according to the game content.
[*] 20 to 30 minutes per play.
[*] This is a test of skill for those who have completed the story mode.
[*] The main content is a story mode, so please think of it as a bonus mode.
[/list]

As for subsequent updates, I'm assuming [b]September or later[/b]
(The detailed date is not yet confirmed due to the current busy schedule)

[list]
[*]Added a feature that allows you to play the second week of the main game.
[*] [b]Change skin with your own image[/b]
[*] [b]Change the job of an existing character[/b]
[/list]

If you have any other requests, please contact me via the thread, twitter, or email.

notes.title: Notice about the next update
notes.content:
[h1]Notice about the next update[/h1]

I am currently working on [b]new stages and bosses[/b]
An update will be coming soon!

As soon as the update is complete.
[b]I am going to start work on a new game mode.[/b]


I am also constantly working to improve the game's balance and visuals.
If you have suggestions on the content, please post it on the board.
